findings.finding: The changes to client.ts, api.ts, and contracts.ts only remove export keywords; parsing at those boundaries is unchanged.

Root cause: ModelConfig made compactThreshold optional for every model, so a Responses entry without it typechecked and sent compact_threshold: undefined. The compaction tests built exactly that config. The fix makes the field required by the union on wire. With the field optional again, the @ts-expect-error fixture fails the typecheck.
archive.ts, attempt.ts, session.ts, database.ts, jobs.ts, and worker.ts changed only by losing export keywords.
typecheck:range writes only into a fresh temporary directory, which it removes.
Every un-exported name has no importer on main or on any local work/ui-* branch, which the measurement checked.
range-typecheck.cjs and exports-check.cjs sit beside audit-check.cjs and security-check.cjs, and each has one npm script and one checks.cjs entry.

Mutations that failed a test: range ignores failures, never shares an install, includes HEAD; assertion allowlist ignored, as const reported, non-null allowed, definite allowed, legacy override removed (lint fails on the 6 legacy assertions); export check ignores namespace imports, counts untracked files, ignores import types, dynamic imports, or re-exports, allows stale entries. One survived: removing commit-types from checks.cjs, because the suite list is owner-reviewed, not tested.
findings.none: Evidence; the survivor is the documented owner-review control.
